decisive_items: numerous round, thin-walled air cysts (2–5 mm) scattered in both lungs
no irregular cyst shapes were noted
response.rationale: Bilateral small round thin-walled cysts with recurrent pneumothoraces in a young woman fit Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome; LAM also causes cysts and pneumothorax but typically shows less uniform round cysts and may have other systemic features, while the given vignette lacks irregular shapes and DLCO is normal.

rejected.why: LAM is plausible but the cysts are described as round and uniform, and DLCO is normal; no extrapulmonary features support LAM over BHD.
